newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam says President Anh still recovering.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam says President Anh still recovering.

text.p: Vietnam said on Thursday that President Le Duc Anh, who has not been seen in public since he suffered a stroke two months ago, was getting better.
"President Le Duc Anh's health is still in the process of recovery," Foreign Ministry spokesman Tran Quang Hoan told reporters at a briefing.
Hoan made no further comment on the health of the 76-year-old former army general, who is a member of the communist country's septuagenarian leadership troika.
Diplomats say Anh has been viewed as a powerful behind-the-scenes operator wielding strong influence over the military and internal security.

Political sources said that although Anh's health has improved, he is not expected to recover sufficiently to resume his duties. They said he would probably remain in place at least until the spring session of the National Assembly, whose approval is required for a successor.
